claim: To increase the cache hit ratio, the origin can add a Cache-Control max-age directive to objects with the longest practical value; the shorter the cache duration, the more often CloudFront sends requests to the origin to check whether an object has changed and to get the latest version.

evidence.quote: The shorter the cache duration, the more frequently CloudFront sends requests to your origin to determine if an object has changed and to get the latest version.

To increase your cache hit ratio, you can configure your origin to add a [Cache-Control max-age](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/Cache-Control) directive to your objects, and specify the longest practical value for `max-age`.
